```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE, error = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Matrix)
    library(ggplot2)
})
```

# Load sampletag alignment counts

Each row of the input TSV is one aligned read: `cb`, `umi`, `sampletag`, `cigar`.

```{r load}
counts_raw <- read.table(gzfile(params$counts_path),
                         sep = "\t", header = FALSE,
                         col.names = c("cb", "umi", "sampletag", "cigar"),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Total aligned sampletag reads: %d\n", nrow(counts_raw)))
cat(sprintf("Unique CBs seen: %d\n", length(unique(counts_raw$cb))))
cat(sprintf("Sampletags detected: %s\n", paste(unique(counts_raw$sampletag), collapse = ", ")))
```

# Aggregate per cell × sampletag

```{r aggregate}
agg <- as.data.frame(table(cb = counts_raw$cb, sampletag = counts_raw$sampletag),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
agg <- agg[agg$Freq > 0, ]

## pivot to wide: rows = cells, cols = sampletags
tags <- unique(counts_raw$sampletag)
cells <- unique(counts_raw$cb)
mat <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(cells), ncol = length(tags),
              dimnames = list(cells, tags))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(agg))) mat[agg$cb[i], agg$sampletag[i]] <- agg$Freq[i]

cat(sprintf("Count matrix: %d cells × %d sampletags\n", nrow(mat), ncol(mat)))
```

# Demultiplexing (≥75% dominant tag = singlet)

```{r demux}
total <- rowSums(mat)
props <- mat / pmax(total, 1L)

dominant_frac <- apply(props, 1, max)
dominant_tag  <- colnames(mat)[apply(props, 1, which.max)]

status <- ifelse(dominant_frac >= 0.75, "singlet", "undetermined")
called <- ifelse(status == "singlet", dominant_tag, NA_character_)

demux <- data.frame(
    cb            = rownames(mat),
    called_tag    = called,
    dominant_frac = round(dominant_frac, 3),
    total_reads   = total,
    status        = status,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print(table(demux$status))
print(table(demux$called_tag, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# Distributions

```{r plots, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ggplot(demux, aes(x = total_reads, fill = status)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "white") +
    labs(title = "Total sampletag reads per cell", x = "Reads", y = "Cells") +
    theme_bw()

ggplot(demux[demux$status == "singlet", ], aes(x = called_tag, fill = called_tag)) +
    geom_bar() +
    labs(title = "Singlet cell counts per sampletag", x = "Sampletag", y = "Cells") +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(demux, aes(x = dominant_frac, fill = status)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.75, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
    labs(title = "Dominant sampletag fraction per cell",
         x = "Fraction of reads from top tag", y = "Cells") +
    theme_bw()
```

# Concordance with ground truth (simulated data only)

```{r concordance}
if (!is.null(params$assignments_path) && nzchar(params$assignments_path) &&
        file.exists(params$assignments_path)) {
    truth <- read.table(params$assignments_path, header = TRUE,
                        sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    ## expected cols: barcode, sampletag
    colnames(truth) <- c("cb", "true_tag")
    merged <- merge(demux, truth, by = "cb", all.x = TRUE)
    n_concordant <- sum(merged$called_tag == merged$true_tag, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_singlet    <- sum(merged$status == "singlet")
    cat(sprintf("Concordance: %d / %d singlets match ground truth (%.1f%%)\n",
                n_concordant, n_singlet, 100 * n_concordant / max(n_singlet, 1)))
    print(table(called = merged$called_tag, truth = merged$true_tag, useNA = "ifany"))
} else {
    cat("No ground-truth assignments file provided — skipping concordance check.\n")
}
```
